bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing tokenization fragmentation (number of subwords), embedding distinctiveness (average cosine similarity), and predictive accuracy in a Masked Language Modeling (MLM) task across 159 different country names.

Correlating representational quality metrics in language models (such as tokenization consistency, semantic distinctiveness in embedding space, and prediction frequency) with the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of nations to demonstrate wealth-based inequities.
